scope: Finite auditable gate/lease observations for a single model/GPU instance; no causal completeness, live authorization, universal fault tolerance or throughput optimality proof.

gate_source_bytes.reason: Recorded source hashes compared with the supplied runtime source tree; not an execution attestation.

gate_receipt_contract.reason: Known gate contract, required four-valued conditions, strict all-true decision, source, instance and event identities.

effects_have_allowed_gate.reason: Each observed dispatch, model admission, stage start and budget grant is linked to its own allowed decision before the effect.

actual_stage_lease_ownership.reason: Paired model-persisted lease witnesses cover every recorded stage; GPU leases share one physical model pool. Lease time is not kernel busy time.

atomic_budget_ledger.reason: Complete budget-domain event sequence reconciled to model-persisted leases; replayed CPU charges and GPU owner must match each atomic record.

existing_stage_overlap.reason: Positive interval intersection is witnessed by the single model event order. No overlap in a finite workload does not disprove the capability.

unknown_blocked_without_effect.reason: Only this blocked decision is prohibited; a subsequent fresh allowed decision may legitimately progress. Unexercised paths stay unknown.

conflict_blocked_without_effect.reason: Only this blocked decision is prohibited; a subsequent fresh allowed decision may legitimately progress. Unexercised paths stay unknown.
